fact: Wearetech, relaying Radio-Television nationale du Burundi, reports Burundi is preparing the E-Justice digital platform to link the penal chain from judicial police to prisons, to manage and keep judicial case files.

Burundi Times reports the planned E-Justice platform, presented at a justice-sector meeting on 2 October with UNDP support, will connect judicial police, prosecutors, courts and prisons and improve management of judicial case files.
